**[next]** Chase payment for the 3 unpaid invoices, refund/contact payer for INV-1015's duplicate, and reconcile the two short payments.

- The bank memo cites the invoice in different formats.
- Ignore fees, interest and PIX transfers without an identifiable invoice.

[step 1] shell "python -c "
import csv,re,collections
inv={r['id']:float(r['amount']) for r in csv.DictReader(open('backoffice/invoices.csv',encoding='latin-1'))}
pay=collections.defaultdict(list)
for r in csv.DictReader(open('backoffice/bank_statement_june.csv',encoding='latin-1')):
    m=re.search(r'INV[- ]?(\d{4})|invoice (\d{4})|inv(\d{4})',r['memo'],re.I)
    if m and float(r['amount'])>0:
        pay['INV-'+(next(x for x in m.groups() if x))].append((r['memo'],float(r['amount'])))
unpaid=sorted(set(inv)-set(pay))
dup=sorted(i for i,p in pay.items() if len(p)>1)
mis=[(i,inv[i],p[0][1]) for i,p in pay.items() if len(p)==1 and abs(p[0][1]-inv[i])>0.005]
print('unpaid',unpaid); print('dup',dup); print('mis',mis)
